description: LATE BOX ARRIVALS 6 - ARM EARLIER. vf4's first geometric gate bails the whole selector unless dir*ball.x >= -5.5, i.e. unless the ball is within 5.5 m of the halfway line or beyond. The midfielder therefore only starts thinking about the run once possession is already advanced. Moving the threshold to -20 m lets the run be prepared during build-up so he is moving when the cross comes. One disp32 re-aim. Watch defensive shape on turnovers.
